title: fix(app-shell): Home asks for the objects it names instead of loading the whole object registry
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBxNE9wTVjSGYnZ9fUpaahr)_ Fixes #29121 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6572592854 · amendment: 6573209598 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:租户首页不再读整张对象注册表(`GET /api/v1/meta/object`)和整张视图表;命令面板第一次打开时才挂载,首页的动态、最近访问、面板最近记录都只按名字读自己用到的对象。 - 为什么改:每次进首页都下载全部对象定义(HotCRM 约 875 KB,app-crm 551 KB),只为一个关着的面板和几行图标、标签;网络慢时首页因此多等。 - 风险与回滚:读法从「一次整表」变成「按名逐个读」,首页请求数多了(app-crm 上 +9 个小请求,合计 70 KB 对 558 KB);进入应用后整表已加载时一律直接用整表,不再发请求。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useObjectPresence.ts`(新的 `readObjectsByName`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeLayout.tsx`(面板首开才挂载)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`(首页无应用时的能力门)。 - 两分钟验证:打开首页,开发者工具 Network 过滤 `meta/object`:只见 `meta/object/<名字>`,没有不带名字的 `meta/object`;按 ⌘K 搜 `acme`,结果与改前一致。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes On `main`, every visit to `/home` read the whole object registry and the whole view list. Measured with CDP initiator stacks on a production Console (app-crm), four readers asked for them unconditionally, each hidden behind the one before by the provider's cache, and four more once there is data: | Reader | Before | Now | |---|---|---| | `HomeLayout`: the command palette's `objects` prop (palette closed) | whole list at mount | palette mounted from its first open; then the host app's scope over its navigation's objects, `views: false` | | `useObjectPresence` outside an app (activity feeds' `sys_activity` check) | whole list | by name, `views: false` | | `useNavMemberGates` outside an app (the feeds' cross-app roster capability gate) | whole list | names-only scope over the app list's `requiresObject` union, `views: false`; the package leg asks without views too | | `HomePage`: recent record row icons | whole list at render | the row's object by name | | `useNavTargetLabel` object label (Home's recent record rows) | whole list | `{ byName: true }` option: the object by name; a view target reads its object with its views | | `useRecentItemLabel`: recent object / list-view rows | whole list | the row's object by name (a view row with its views) | | `ActivityObjectLabel`: activity rows (Home rail, bell) | whole list | the row's object by name | | `CommandPalette` recent record rows (palette open) | whole list | the row's object by name | `readObjectsByName` (in `useObjectPresence.ts`) is the one helper: while nothing has loaded the whole list it asks each name through the names-only scope (objectui#12980); once the list is loaded or loading it reads the list and asks nothing; a hand-rolled context reads its `objects`; no name asks nothing (a names-only scope with no names would be the whole registry). Every in-app leg is unchanged: inside an app the sidebar, routes and gates read what they read before. The palette's record search reads only its navigation's objects (`useRecordSearch` with `objectNames`), so handing it the host app's scope over those names leaves its results unchanged. ## Tests Request-count tests over the real `MetadataProvider` and a fake adapter that records each read: - `console/home/__tests__/homeObjectReads-29121.test.tsx`: presence check, roster gate (answers as the whole list did, including an absent required object), activity label, an empty-names read; CONTROL: with the whole list loaded each reader asks nothing. - `console/home/__tests__/HomeLayout.paletteReads-29121.test.tsx`: closed palette not mounted and no read; opened (click or `?palette=1`) reads `object?package=…` plus the outside name; a package-less app reads by name only. - `console/home/__tests__/HomePage.recentObjectReads-29121.test.tsx`: no recent row → no read; record rows read their objects by name (icon and label pinned); an object row by name and a list-view row with its views (`view`, never `object`). - `chrome/CommandPalette.recentReadsByName-29121.test.tsx`: the palette's recent rows read their objects by name. - Updated pins: `HomeLayout.searchOpensPalette-12601` (the palette probe exists from the first open), `navGateUnionScope-12980` (its "outside an app reads the whole registry" control now pins the by-name read), `openPathObjectReaders-12811` (the census learns `readObjectsByName(…)` as a spelling and a `byName` kind; HomeLayout, HomePage, ActivityObjectLabel and useRecentItemLabel reclassified). ## Acceptance notes - **Files beyond the amendment's seven:** `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` (the palette's recent rows, its object source while open; found on the production re-measure) and the three updated test pins above. - **Acceptance 1** (no unscoped `GET /api/v1/meta/object` on home): met on app-crm, see Verification. The home now asks the 8 `requiresObject` names of the Setup app's navigation by name (the roster gate), plus `sys_activity` and the objects its recent and activity rows name. That is more requests than one list (19 → 28 on app-crm) and far fewer bytes (558 KB → 70 KB). There is no batch by-names read on `/meta/object` today. - **Acceptance 2** (palette object search unchanged): the palette's text for `acme` is byte-identical between main and this branch on the same server. - The card's premise named only the palette. Measuring showed it was the first of four unconditional readers; the claim was amended (6573209598) to the full shape. - Not changed: a recent dashboard / page / report row still reads that type's list (`useRecentItemLabel`), and opening the palette reads `/meta/report` and `/meta/dataset` (its report entries). Neither is the object registry. ## Verification
Home requests, production Console, app-crm (objectstack dev --fresh), recent records and activity rows present main `0a41075a`: 19 `/api/` requests on reload of `/home`, including `GET /api/v1/meta/object` (551,461 bytes) and `GET /api/v1/meta/view` (6,643 bytes); the initiator of both is `HomeLayout` (`get objects`). This branch `5705cea1`: 28 requests; no `GET /api/v1/meta/object` without a name and no `/meta/view`. By name: `sys_business_unit`, `sys_notification`, `sys_notification_preference`, `sys_notification_template`, `sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`, `sys_record_share`, `sys_sharing_rule` (Setup's `requiresObject` entries), `sys_activity`, `crm_contact`, `crm_account` (recent and activity rows): 70,164 bytes together. Opening the palette and typing reads `object?package=com.example.crm` (31,636 bytes), `/meta/report`, `/meta/dataset`. Same page on both: recent rows' text and icons, activity rows' labels, and the activity feed's `sys_activity` filter (21 object names) are identical.
Ablations (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with git diff HEAD empty) - A1 palette mounted while closed → `HomeLayout.paletteReads` "closed" red. - A2 presence check keeps the whole list outside an app → `homeObjectReads` presence red. - A3 roster gate keeps the whole list outside an app → `homeObjectReads` gate red. - A4 `readObjectsByName` returns the whole list → activity label, empty-names, both HomePage row cases red (4). - A5 HomePage icon reads `metadata.objects` → record rows red. - A6 `useNavTargetLabel` ignores `byName` → both HomePage row cases red. - A7 `useRecentItemLabel` title reads `metadata.objects` → object/view row case red. - A8 palette scope composed with views → both opened cases red. - A9 / A10 palette recent icon / label read the whole list → `CommandPalette.recentReadsByName` red.
Local runs at 5705cea1 - 91 test files naming the touched modules (`CommandPalette`, `useNavTargetLabel`, `readObjectsByName`, the census): 90 files / 802 tests passed (one name listed twice). Earlier heads: 88 files naming the seven hooks/components (2 expected pins updated, then green) and 151 files naming `sharedUserFeeds`, `InboxPopover`, `RecentApps`, `HomeRail`, `CommandPalette`, `AppHeader`: 620 + 498 tests passed. - `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 tasks. - `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: 0 errors. - Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) at `d8b43ffa`: 34 derived, 34 run, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED); `check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0 among them. The full app-shell suite is CI's Test UI.
## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched) - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01QsR2jSvXnowXjLpyfdKoux
